items.html: And behold, when we combine these two names, they total 728 in Gematria, for these are the upper Achoraim [backs], as above. And from them faces were made below them, and it is found that in them is the discernment of Bina, called Samech, and the discernment of Tevuna, called closed Mem. And the Klipa [shell] that corresponds to Bina and Tevuna is called MaS, and this is the reason the Minister of Forgetting is called MaS. For these names, which total 728 in Gematria, are in Bina and Tevuna, called MaS. And from there comes forgetting, since they are Achoraim, and the Klipot called MaS take hold of them.
